answer: Gate earnings behind a verified work history. New identities start at zero earning power and must pass 50 small tasks checked by established peers. Only then does the cap rise; one fraud finding wipes the history to zero. Honest agents climb once and stay in the Nectar registry. Swarm operators repeat the climb per fake, at two dollars per task, one fake costs 100 dollars and 1,000 fakes 100,000 dollars, while each check costs one signature. One fake caught and the ripple spreads through its links and wipes every linked history, so the swarm falls apart like a raven scattering decoys.
